visualCharacteristics.purpose: FAQ search box with heading that filters FAQ items on the page or searches a query index

contentPattern.structure: content rows (heading, intro); config rows [source] [query-index link, optional], [label], [placeholder], [button], [no results] [message], [limit] [10]. Without source it filters details / .accordion-item / .faq-item elements in main

reuseGuidance: Use above FAQ accordions or as an FAQ search entry point.
